description: Implementation of disk cache file operations for Windows, including asynchronous IO handling, file initialization, read/write, and length management.

classes.name: CompletionHandler
classes.description: Handles IO completion notifications for asynchronous file operations on Windows.

classes.name: MyOverlapped
classes.description: Represents overlapped IO operation data, including callback and context.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file object with a given filename, opening handles for overlapped IO.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Performs synchronous or asynchronous read operations on the file.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Performs synchronous or asynchronous write operations on the file.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Retrieves the current length of the file.
